limits: Selected coverage, not a random population sample.
Each isolated group contains equally many forward and reverse targets, with six or twelve operations in total.
Injected input timing includes delivery and handler work.
Same-surface references do not independently prove native frame PTS.
Capture completion gives sampling upper bounds, not exact display or subjective latency.
APK hashes bind the installed artifacts designated by the operator; raw timings do not independently authenticate them.
